subject: Taxes
title: The Alternative Minimum Tax
description: Learn The Alternative Minimum Tax in one minute.

hook.text: The AMT is a shadow tax system. It recalculates your tax without most deductions to ensure high earners pay a minimum.

buildup.text: Congress created the AMT in 1969 after 155 wealthy Americans paid zero income tax using legal deductions.

discovery.text: The AMT calculates your tax two ways—regular and AMT—then makes you pay whichever is higher. No escaping it.

twist.text: The AMT wasn't indexed to inflation for decades. By 2017, it hit millions of middle-class families it never targeted.

climax.text: The AMT is a cautionary tale: a tax designed for 155 millionaires eventually trapped millions of ordinary people.

punchline.text: Designed for 155 millionaires. Expanded to hit millions. The AMT lesson.

quiz.question: Why was the Alternative Minimum Tax created?
options: To ensure wealthy Americans pay a minimum amount of tax
